newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady to up.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady to higher on Monday amid fairly subdued activity, U.S. millfeed dealers said.
Several dealers said they were focusing on the runup in CBOT corn and the soy complex, noting that wheat middlings were priced lower than corn.
"We are up with the stronger grain market," a St Louis dealer said. "The higher the corn prices go, the more the hog and cattle feeders will be interested in wheat midds. That is the theory anyway."
Another dealer noted that grain futures prices have been strong in the past week, resellers have been short and flour mill run times have been poor.
"If we can get some followthrough on the corn and the bean market, it will affect wheat and other ingredients as well," a Minnesota dealer said.
Supplies are tight and players are defensive in view of rising futures prices, a Texas dealer said.
